continuity_state: Mriya refused Good Dog and Bad Dog, temporarily lost provisional benefits and unlocked Stray through loyalty offered without command or fear. Chosen Route forms a party whose rewards require renewed consent. Current inhabitants are Mriya, Nika, Borscht, Emil and Pixel; Atlas remains a non-member visitor who chose to guard them. They restored a hidden sanitation room as a Pack Hearth by contributing private scent markers under negotiated privacy rules. The Hearth healed Mriya's hip and broadcast the settlement. Rook and two disciplined dogs have arrived to challenge or negotiate for the territory.
